notes.title: Sounds and interface fix
notes.content:
Sounds management change: no more too much sounds at the same time and music isn't turned off when a lot of sounds are at the same time
Change and upscale the " can attack flying units", to make it more readable and understandable
Fix in battle descritpion pop up, that was under some elements
Up the base biomass value of flying creatures but decrease the value added with the battel difficulty

notes.title: Creatures skill balance
notes.content:
Fixed maths for temporary acceleration and slow
Special abilities of healers and lords are activated less often and for a shorter amount of time, to balance the creatuers skills power increase

notes.title: Fixes and visual effects
notes.content:
Biomass value increase of flying creatures with difficulty progression has been lowered
Fixed the pollen skill being able to be used again before the previous one has been layered down
Fixed the target of the pollen skill being unable to get over a limit on the ground
Fixed the creature sepcial power (heal, speed up, etc...) multiplicator with the game progress
Change the creatures damage visual effects, hit received by plants or pollen area are more visibles

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed Ballistacea description that shows bad icon for flying unit attack
Fixed map 50 and 60
Changed loot of one mushroom that was mixed with an other
Adding an unlock verification system, to get back plants you should have unlocked and missed

notes.title: Quality of life and tutorials
notes.content:
Add a circle around the new cursor, when you try to buy a new plant or flower 
Change Polleno talk window: the color, to fit the character and the size is now scaling with screen resolution
Change flower tutorials, split in two parts and much more clearer
Basic use of pollen got downed to 5 (was 11 before) but cost upgrade by new flower was up to 2 (was 1 before) to bring a better use of the power  early in the game, when we don't have all upgrades to get more skill use freaquency
Add a tooltip to show the the shortcut for pollen skill (E) on overring the flower and in tutorials

notes.title: UI feedback and pollen changes
notes.content:
. Add feedbacks on interfaces for:

Pollen quantity by second you earn on pollen bar
Pollen quantity needed on hovering the pollen menu
Stats added when leveling up a plant, on hovering the level up button


One thing that came, when playing on highest levels with the new flowers balance, is that pollen active skill was too powerful on level start and too weak at the end and it was too "spamming". I added some improvement and behavior changes to have a more growing power and cost that bring a skill that need to be used less frequently but with greatest effects:
. Add an upgrade in the garden, for the Solariane, that upgrade all pollen power by 5% and increase pollen cost by 1, with 10 levels
. The pollen skill cost increase by 1 for each flower and the pollen area ticks its attacks 1 time more for each flower

notes.title: V1.0 ! It's here!
notes.content:
Balance stats of all plants, mainly upgraded, to get real power upgrade while using biomass
Add a credit scene, that evolve with number of maps discovered, that shows all plants and creature you know and some stats about your journey
Fix various visual bugs
Add a plant's model, in the upgrade menu, to get a visual
Creature special abilities (heal area, buff area, etc...) are now increased with difficulty. They were, before, with static stats, now they are less powerful from start but get more powerful with time and ripening going on... Beware!
Various upgrades, like biomass cost for all plants, have been added


All upgrades will be reset! Go check back in the garden to reinvest your cells!

Some other updates are already planned, to add quality of life, new upgrades and maybe new content!u!

notes.title: Last mechanics and visual update
notes.content:
Fix a bug on flowers and fruit upgrade menu, when refunding
Fix a bug where challenge levels icons has vanished
Slight challenge change:

Level 2 bring Slugiciola, that was on level 3 before
Level 3 brings flying creature that can heal ground ones or can deactivate plants
Level 4 in unchanged but Lords spawn frequency is lower

Flying creatures you call after using pollen are all harmless ones that can bring gound amount of biomass, it's all bonus if you take time to have anti air plants!
Some text fix
Liquid surface shader upgrade
Add all missing sounds (mainly plants attacks)
Rework of some area effect visuals, for a clear vision
Add more details on main map
Add and update visuals of all biomes
Map ending menu update

notes.title: Polish: refund and rebind
notes.content:
Add a refund button in all upgrades panels
Add a new rebind menu in settings
Add a vegetal wall to represent "physicaly" the fruit protection
Fixed some colliding problem in some maps
Main map still get more details

notes.title: Polish phase start!
notes.content:
Add a sound and a special effect when a plant activate a special power
Same thing for each step of destruction of the cristal that contains the bonus seed
Add some plant's attack sound
Fix a abd behavior when selling plants ad optimize attacks
Starting rework of the water surfaces shader


This is the beginning of long polish phase to have a better experience ingame!

notes.title: Big content update!
notes.content:
News

All levels are available: 81 classic levels and 19 bonus levels
All plants and flowers are available: 4 basic plants, 24 mutations and 4 flowers
Last biome is in place!
Add a new challenge mode, after clearing the last level (level 81)


Balance

Pollen area lifetime is now 3 seconds that get 1 second bonus for each flower on the battlefield (upgrades to get more lifetime will come in the future)

notes.title: Let's keep going with ingame content...
notes.content:
News

Add a shortcut(TAB by default for now), in battle, that shows/hide upgrade level and mutation level of plants
Add maps 60 to 64
Add plant Potathump and Cauldron


Balances

Biomass gain from flowers have been slightly lowered, this amount becoming too crazy with multiple flowers on battleground


Fix

Hovering a plant is now displaying correctly stats, and will no more have a "random" behavior
This display will now show if multiple attacks and/or status are now on the plant

notes.title: New levels and various fixes
notes.content:
News

Add a new flying creature: the Moskito, it has no active skill, it just goes around quickly et can reward a good amount of biomass by killing it
Add levels 48 to 59 and bonus 13 to 16
Add plants Karactus and Balistacea


Balancing

When summonig a flying creature, the Moskito will be the first and most common one
The other flying ones chances to be picked have been reduced, to have to more chance to get a good reason to try getting more ressources by doing so
The nibblers biomass amount increase is smaller, this amount became too massive with the time...
Larvas spawned by the Queens don't count on death counter anymore



Fix

New UI bar for ripening, to get it more visible

notes.title: New maps and rebalance
notes.content:
New

Add a power upgrade for the Sporelle
Add the flower Orchidacid, taht add damage over time and armor reduction to the pollen
Add a visual effect, around the plant creation and upgrade buttons, to have a direct feedback of the biomass quantity you have and how much it costs


Balance

All plants and flowers stats have been upgraded
Change while calculting the difficulty, ennemies get stronger he more you kill
The Anesthesik flying creature can cast its special ability to disable plants from further away and the disabled visual effect is more visible



Fix

On main map, change of the map description pannl: the minimum ripening (that is just a linear number) has been replaced by a simple "ripening complete"
You can, in fact, win a game without having managed to bring the fruit to maturity, which is the condition for unlocking the next level. It wasn't clear enough
Map 31 modification: the south secondary path is longer now, it was way too short before
Pollen can now hit flying creatures
Add a cooldown time of 2 seconds by default for each flying creature call

notes.title: Flowers change, balance and polish
notes.content:
Flowers feature changes

To make flowers use more relevant, the base price has been downed from 40 to 20
Insect spawn is now a manual skill, letting players choose whether want challenge or not
The flying insect "Sweety" is no more invoked by the Apetizer plant, but is now one of the possible insect called by the new active skil
The Apetizer has changed to become the Necrophagia, its special is now a chance to convert dead ennemies around into biomass


Balance

The increase rate of upgrades, in the garden, has been re-upped
The special power of the Gobbler can't be upgrade no more than level 4, giving, at max upgrade, 40% chance to produce 5 biomass
The Chewer no longer slows down its targets
Slow down conditions can no longer stop ther targets. Only specials having this particular trait, like the rooter one, can really stop the Nibblers
Upgrades refunded
To let the player choose a mutation by use and not price, all mutations of the same tier cost the same price to buy and upgrade


Fix and add

Add stats, in the garden upgrade menus: damage over time (called "conditions"), the number of conditions applied by each attack and the time it remains
Fix a bug that made the biomass number wasn't updated when using it in pause
Fix a bug that prevent the challenge menu to be properly shown and updated, on main map, when you unlock a new challenge level
Add a new model modification, on the Nibblers spawn, which correspond to the challenge level

notes.title: Visual improvements
notes.content:
Add a tooltip, on hovering each of the number in the objective bars, to better identify each value
Add a more relevant model when planting a new sprout is impossible
Improve the stones model, around flowers, to better distinguish them from other plants

notes.title: v0.64 Add maps and upgrades rework
notes.content:
Add 6 levels and 2 bonus
Change the Stinger name to Itcher, the old name being more appropriate for its mutation
Add 3 plants: Stinger, Monstruous and Root-Swallower
Adjusting the Crusher, slower but more powerful, pure raw damage
Add missing descriptions
Improving the color change system, when creature tak damage, making damage over time more visible
Improving plants stats pannel, in the garden, showing a few more stats and displaying the damage value under the cost, this stat being more relevant
Improving Nibblers corpses stock, in the Sacrifice Tree
The price curve for upgrades in the garden has been reworked, to softer
Plants special abilities have a base activation chance of 10%, and there's less chance activation upgrade, but it's up of 2 instead of 1, making the all levels cost less
Total refund of all upgrades
Resize the main map interface, to clear space on screen


More stats display, on the upgrade menu, will be available next...

notes.title: Challenge mode fix
notes.content:
Fixed bugs with challenge unlock and selection buttons
Lighten a little more horror themed maps

notes.title: UI update
notes.content:
Challenge interface improvement

Adding a menu, on main map, to select challenge level
Challenge levels unlock is more obvious and what challenge/reward bring is more clear

Upgrades menus improvement

In upgrades menus, adding base stats ans bonus stats for each plant
Bar graphs come with these statistiques, to get a clear view and scale value
Special skills get this new system too
Bugs on Skinner upgrade panel got fixed

notes.title: The challeng update!
notes.content:
The challenge update!
Today, a global upgrade of the Sacrifice Tree, in the Garden:

Modification of the Nibblers bodies number bar, for a more comprehensive feature and a better look
Adding a visual effect, at the bottom of the Sacrifice tree and in the Sacrifice menu, to show up the corpses consume skill is ready to use
Upgrading the corpses stock is cheaper
Increasing the number of cells earned by consuming the corpses
Adding difficulty unlock buttons, that need corpses to be unlocked
As soon as you'll unlock the first difficulty upgrade, the button for difficulty choice for level 1 and 2 will appear


Levels of difficulty

Level 1 : Base difficulty, no modification
Level 2 : The creatures get stronger over time, in addition to normal difficulty increase. Cells reward +10%
Level 3 : More difficulty increase and new creatures and new creatures appear. Cells reward +20%
Level 4 : Nibblers are, again, more powerful and the Overlords come into battle!. Cells reward + 30%
Add one new creature for level 3: Slugiciola, a bulky Nibbler that spread slime that spead up creature getting on it
Add one new creature for level 4: Overlord, a mighty Nibbler that walk slowly and spit mucus that  increase armor and max life of others creatures

notes.title: Version 0.53 + 0.54: Maps, balancing and new plants
notes.content:
Version 0.53 +  0.54: Maps, balancing and new plants
Due to an error, the patch note for v0.53 did not passed, so here are the last two versions:


 Bonus maps 5 and 6 is fixed
 Add a shortcut for pollen zone (e by default for now)
 Light increase for Slapper and Grinder damage, to be more effective on raw damage type of plant
 Adding a preview on plant range before buying it
 Light increase for mushrooms range, reflecting a more area of damage type of plants
 Increase of biomass gain from Digestiflore skill, to get the use of flower more rewarding
 Add lmaps 30 to 35 and bonus 7, 8 and 9
 Add new plants: Crusher, Skinner and Spreader
 Add a new biomass starting bonus in the graden, in Fruit upgrades
 Change base starting price for all 4 branches of plants to 30 biomass and all base plant have a cost upgrade that have a max elvel 5... find your way to fight with all starting the same cost! 
 Add a visual effect to show progression road between levels, on main map
